summary: AI engineer with four years shipping production LLM and agentic systems end to end, including secure integrations and automation across real operational workflows. I take AI features from prototype to production — retrieval, prompt and output-guardrail design, evaluation and monitoring — with strong Python, APIs, and databases. I work client-facing and ship reliably in complex, high-stakes domains.

bullets: Owned the full AI feature lifecycle in production: architecture, retrieval and prompt design, output validation, deployment, and monitoring.
Built an LLM-powered clinical decision-support agent that retrieves patient history and generates medication and diagnostic guidance for clinicians in a high-stakes domain.
Designed the retrieval, prompt, and output-guardrail layers for a production chatbot, improving reliability and reducing hallucination risk.
Built the retrieval and data layer (Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis); caching and optimized queries improved data-access performance by **30%** for high-frequency inference calls.
Built an AI-driven platform with LangChain and RAG pipelines, integrating third-party data and retrieving context to generate personalized outputs.
Developed an AI Virtual Trainer agent with agentic reasoning and personalization, increasing user engagement by **40%**; owned design, development, and deployment.
Built SmartMedHx (Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL), applying LLM extraction to automate workflows and reduce manual data handling.
Engineered a GPT-Canvas-style streaming LLM renderer achieving **98%** rendering accuracy.
Built Refill Arena from zero to **$1M+ revenue**, owning backend infrastructure, data models, and scalable APIs across **3,200+ brands** and **190+ countries**.
Delivered features end to end with remote stakeholders; improved backend performance by **25%** and implemented JWT auth and Stripe subscriptions.
